text:
Maya: Heads up — spike in embed telemetry from oversized dims (>1024).
Chris: How big? numbers?
Maya: ~4x sample events, 3 tenants responsible. sampler is applied pre-splitter which amplifies fan-out.
Devon: That explains it. engineering idea: add tenant-level sampling override in runtime config so noisy tenants can be lowered without a full deploy.
Sara: Console UX idea: show "effective sampling rate" per tenant and a one-click "reduce noise" suggestion that proposes a rate based on recent event ratio.
Chris: Ops requirements: audit log when Console overrides sampling + a metric label flagging runtime_override=true so dashboards can filter.
Devon: I'll implement precedence header < tenant_override < default and emit a dim_bucket histogram (low-card buckets: 0-64,65-256,257-1024,>1024). keep event labels minimal.
Maya: Rollout plan: canary override to one tenant for 24h, monitor sampled_event_rate, latency, and alert churn.
IngressBot: deploy-bot: canary sampling override applied to tenant_x on 2024-11-05T02:12:00Z.
MonitoringBot: alert cleared: embed-sample-event volume returned to baseline after override.
Maya: Owners: Devon (middleware + metric PR), Sara (Console mock + CTA), Chris (alerts + support blurb). tag owners and will reconvene after 24h canary.
